create_assemblyai_passthrough_logging_ha: create an AssemblyAI passthrough logging handler that polls for transcript completion and logs cost
poll_assembly_for_transcript_response: poll the AssemblyAI API for transcript response until it reaches completed or error status
get_cost_for_assembly_transcript: get the cost for an AssemblyAI transcript based on audio duration and speech model
get_cost_per_second_for_assembly_model: get the per-second cost for a given AssemblyAI speech model with fallback to nano
